description: Evidence labels for Phase 3 mechanics. VERIFIED_RULE means a cached community/official reference explicitly states it; it does not grant redistribution rights. No DaddyRaegen, DanUgore, Elvlin, Altema or Fandom asset is imported.

brave_shift.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
brave_shift.note: Separate synthetic form definitions and a deterministic two-turn cooldown are project-authored. Original shift types and timing were not independently recovered.

super_limit_burst.label: UNVERIFIED_RULE
super_limit_burst.note: EX-gated synthetic fixture actions; no verified GL/JP cost, gauge or timing table was recovered.

leader_skill.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
leader_skill.note: Category-filtered additive stat bonus for synthetic categories only.

unit_categories.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
unit_categories.note: Synthetic category tags; original category rosters were not imported.

trust_ability.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
trust_ability.note: Trust points and TMR/STMR claims are authored fixture rules.

equipment_passives.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
equipment_passives.note: Stat passives are authored; equipment slot restrictions are synthetic.

vision_card_bonuses.label: REMASTERED_DESIGN
vision_card_bonuses.note: Card level scaling and category gates are authored.

dual_wield.label: VERIFIED_RULE
dual_wield.note: Cached community wiki states physical/hybrid actions attack twice and LBs are unaffected; the synthetic second-hit schedule is a desktop approximation.

multicast.label: PARTIAL_RULE
multicast.note: Queueing multiple actions is supported; original cast-delay and per-skill unlock rules are not recovered.

killers.label: PARTIAL_RULE
killers.note: A synthetic race-tag damage modifier is modelled; exact original race tables and stacking exceptions are not implemented.

weapon_imperil.label: PARTIAL_RULE
weapon_imperil.note: Elemental imperil is implemented in the existing engine; weapon-specific imperil values remain a data extension only.

imbue_amplification.label: PARTIAL_RULE
imbue_amplification.note: Fixture passive fields exist; no verified amplification cap or duration was recovered.

overdrive.label: UNVERIFIED_RULE
overdrive.note: One synthetic EX-gated action per battle; original activation limits and action economy are unverified.
